name: The fabric's intent->capability ROUTER (the posterior decision engine)
description: Andrew-direct via MSTR (LD-0232, 2026-07-01) -- ELEVATED from the COMPLEARN §4a fold (LD-0231): the routing DECISION engine gets its own first-class project. Today routing is homeless (scattered across comp-which curated RULES + the manifest fuzzy backstop + the §4a tenant); comp-which is the SURFACE, not the router; the DE's per-tool fixes (comp-drift/comp-cluster) are O(1) one-offs -- the ALPHA is the ENGINE. THE FOUR-PEER ANTI-META-DRIFT CONTRACT (disjoint verbs): COMPRAIL/TOOLHUD FIRES (when-to-route+HUD+gate) / COMPROUTE DECIDES (the posterior -- NEW) / COMPUNIFY MAPS (one-home capability catalog = the PRIOR) / COMPLEARN TRAINS (tool_activity+affinity = the LEARNED signal). COMPROUTE consumes COMPUNIFY(prior)+COMPLEARN(learned), is fired by COMPRAIL; comp-which = its first surface. THE POSTERIOR (re-homed from §4a, c15aad2d9, preserved): score(cap)=w_q*query_match+w_s*surface_prior+w_h*history_affinity + margin-disambiguation gate (never silent-argmax) + PRIOR-not-FILTER invariant + cold-start degradation + the 2 grounded failure modes. THE SYSTEMS ALPHA = the GENERALIZATION INTERFACE: capability-map-AGNOSTIC from Stage 1 -- same engine routes ANY intent->capability via a pluggable capability-map provider. Stage 1 comp-tools (near-term, off ~E's live tool_activity + the live COMPUNIFY map) -> Stage 2 skills/MCP/docs -> Stage 3 agent/lane DISPATCH (TO->lane becomes LEARNED not hand-mapped). O(compounding) vs O(1)-decaying curated rules. 5 CTO rulings (PRD §6). Goodhart-anchored (CTO-owned risk shared w/ COMPLEARN, CVO~B-verified). Read-side lane-portable (org/modules/graph/, shell to comp-kuzu --json; registration = governor's act). The DE's LD-0231 curated fixes (comp-drift live 9fe941ef8; comp-cluster pending) = COMPROUTE's cold-start priors.
phase: COMPLETE (Stage-1) 2026-07-01 (2-step close, COO~B).
